name: car
description: scanned 1/10 RoboRacer (the real car): 186 photos (Panasonic GM1), COLMAP + 3DGUT, metric scale and floor from 4 ChArUco sheets; colours scaled to the hallway lighting; rear axle origin
frame: asset frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres; origin on the floor, below the rear axle (kind car) or at the footprint centre (kind static)

splat.layout: little endian, no header: position f32 (N,3), scale f32 (N,3), rotation f32 (N,4) wxyz, density f32 (N,), sh f16 (N,48) coefficient-major; as a scene splat.bin, in the asset frame

source.method: photo scan, COLMAP SfM, 3DGUT (3dgrut), cropped and re-centred
source.colour_gain_note: fit from GM1 RAW photos of the car in the hallway vs the hallway splat walls
